page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a centred closing line "FINIS.", an ornament below it, and a library stamp in the lower centre (not transcribed). Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: fuerit, ostendunt. Qua quoniam sunt à nobis explicata, & opus ipsum institutum ad finem iam & umbilicum perductum, expositaq; sunt à nobis veterissimi Mundi Antiquitates, laudem Deo Opt. Max. (tanquam nauta, qui ex longa navigatione portum tandem attigerunt) canamus, & infinitam illius in primi Mundi administratione Sapientiam, Potentiam, Iustitiam, ac Misericordiâ agnoscamus, admiremur, celebremus, quæ elucet, vti demonstravimus.
Patri vero, & Filio, & Spiritui Sancto, qui sunt vnus ille Deus, laus, & gloria in æternum, & vltra. Amen.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Text in the upper part of the page is set in italic type; "Amen." and the closing words are italic. The ornament below FINIS is a printer's cross-like device. A library stamp (ex-libris, partly legible) sits in the lower centre and is not transcribed. Some words at the top are partly faded; "Qua" and "Patri" read as printed. Page furniture: running head "MVNDI ÆTATE." and page number 487 at top.
